channel.title: Happy News Company
channel.description: Real, sourced good news and good-news press releases

item.title: WWF's Living Planet Report Finds a "Rational Basis for Hope" as Tigers, Turtles and Elephants Recover
item.description: Wild tiger numbers are up more than 70% in 15 years, and green sea turtles and Atlantic bluefin tuna are no longer listed as Endangered.

item.title: [Press Release] Happy News Company Launches Press Release Publishing for Organizations Sharing Good News
item.description: Companies, nonprofits and community groups can publish impact stories from $99, with 25% off for registered nonprofits.

item.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry Honors Kagan and Soai for Discoveries That Help Make Better Medicines
item.description: The two chemists showed how a tiny molecular preference can be amplified, a key to producing drugs in the right "handed" form.

item.title: HP and WWF Have Now Protected and Restored More Than 600,000 Acres of Forest, With Viet Nam and Mexico Next
item.description: The partnership aims for another 400,000 acres by 2030 and includes a $1 million gift this year.

item.title: Trail Cameras Capture 529 Elephants Using Tanzania's First Protected Wildlife Corridor
item.description: The nearly 9-mile corridor reconnects savanna herds with the Udzungwa Mountains.

item.title: "Lost" Ghana Cuckooshrike Spotted Again After 13 Years
item.description: Researchers found the rare bird in Côte d'Ivoire's Taï National Park.

item.title: Electric Cars Are Now Up to Nine Times Cheaper to Drive Than Petrol in the UK
item.description: Meanwhile EVs went from 1 in 100 new cars to 1 in 5 in Turkey in just a few years.

item.title: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library Passes 300 Million Free Books, and Now There's a Coffee for It
item.description: Cup of Ambition, made with Community Coffee, sends proceeds to the program that mails books to young children.

item.title: California Legalizes Plug-In "Balcony Solar," Opening Clean Power to Renters
item.description: Small panels that plug into a wall outlet no longer need utility permission under the new Plug and Play Solar Act.

item.title: Child Drowning Deaths Have Fallen by About Three-Quarters Since 1980
item.description: The global rate for children under five dropped from roughly 30 to 7.4 per 100,000.

item.title: Reintroduced Beavers Are Bringing a Utah River Back to Life
item.description: Their dams on the Price River are helping fish, improving water health and buffering drought.

item.title: FDA Approves AbbVie's JUVMO, the First New Type of Dopamine Drug for Parkinson's in Decades
item.description: The once-daily pill targets different dopamine receptors than existing options and is expected in U.S. pharmacies this month.

item.title: Broadway Flea Market Raises Nearly $1.5 Million for HIV/AIDS Relief Despite Stormy Weather
item.description: The 40th edition brought the event's all-time total to more than $22 million for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

item.title: Alzheimer's Is Starting to Be Seen as Treatable and Preventable, World Alzheimer Report Says
item.description: Researchers say clinical trials are nearing diagnostic and medical breakthroughs.

item.title: First-Ever Treatment for "Childhood Alzheimer's" Approved as FDA Clears Ultragenyx Gene Therapy
item.description: Families facing Sanfilippo syndrome type A now have "hope and an action plan," advocates say.

item.title: Kentucky Will Erase $250 Million in Medical Debt, No Application Required
item.description: The first letters go to 46,000 residents whose combined debts top $100 million.
